title: Where can I find the recording for a session?
content: Recordings are posted in the #recordings channel within 24 hours of the live session. If a recording isn't listed yet, it's still processing — check back the next day before asking.

title: The recording cut off / is missing a section, what do I do?
content: Flag it in #support with the session name and the approximate timestamp where it cuts off. The team re-uploads a corrected version when this happens.

title: Which session covered chunking strategies?
content: Chunking strategies were covered in the Week 3 session, "RAG Fundamentals — Retrieval and Chunking," specifically the second half after the break.

title: Which session covered embeddings?
content: Embeddings were introduced in the Week 2 session, "Vector Representations," and revisited in Week 3 in the context of retrieval.

title: Where can I find the session slides?
content: Slides are linked at the top of each session's notes document, posted the same day as the live session.

title: Who was the guest speaker in a given week?
content: See the Guest Speaker List — each entry lists the speaker, their session, and topic.

title: Session Notes: Week 2 — Vector Representations
content: Key concepts: embeddings, vector space, cosine similarity, embedding models. Summary: Introduced how text is converted into vector embeddings, why distance in vector space approximates semantic similarity, and a comparison of common embedding models.

title: Session Notes: Week 3 — RAG Fundamentals — Retrieval and Chunking
content: Key concepts: chunking strategies, chunk overlap, RAG, vector databases. Summary: Covered the RAG pipeline end to end: chunking documents, embedding chunks, storing them in a vector database, and retrieving relevant chunks at query time. Chunking strategy (fixed-size vs. semantic) covered in the second half.
